_about: Short lists this trade has fixed by decision rather than by convention. Each was written into the tenant guide as prose, or lived only in the superseded PROJECT_REPORT.md — which means the guide could drift from the specification and nothing would notice. They are data here so one file answers, and so 'locked' can be checked instead of asserted.
_what_locked_means: The list is closed today, not closed forever. A tenant adds an entry through core/tenant.js like any other change: effective-dated, append-only, and the closed months keep the list that applied then. What 'locked' rules out is a value appearing in a record that is not on the list — a lead whose source is a free-text guess, or a service sent to a vendor nobody appointed.

service_providers._source: Master spec §B.2.5 'Third-party services (Stage 3B)' and §6's '7 locked service providers (seed)'. The two lists name the same seven, in the same pairings.
service_providers._these_are_businesses: Vendor names here are counterparties — firms this business buys a service from — not staff. The roster rule that keeps a person's name out of a committed document does not reach a supplier's trading name, which appears on every purchase order the business sends.
service_providers._priority: Each service also has a priority ladder: contact Priority-1, then Priority-2, then Priority-3. The seven above are the Priority-1 seed; the ladder itself lives in the vendors table, not here.

crm_lead_sources._source: Master spec §4 CRM, 'Sources (locked): IndiaMART, Website, WhatsApp, Walk-in, Forum.' The reference implementation checks the list literally — its own self-test returns 'sources locked' if the five ever differ.

no_rate_designs._source: §16A. Five designs the rates master has no rate for; they are costed ₹0 and flagged, never estimated.
no_rate_designs._why_not_locked: This list is an observation about one dataset, not a decision. A rate arriving for any of the five removes it, and a new design without one adds to it. It is here so the repository stops saying 'five designs with no rate' without ever saying which.
